summary: The MaintRequestCodes system manages request codes within an organization. It allows for the creation, update, deletion, and reactivation of request codes, categorized by Program or SubDiscipline. The system involves user roles such as System Administrator and Local Administrator, affecting visibility and editability of controls.
purpose: The system supports maintaining request codes used for categorizing various organizational elements by program or sub-discipline. It provides administrators with tools to manage these codes efficiently.

actors.name: System Administrator
actors.description: User role with full access to manage request codes.

actors.name: Local Administrator
actors.description: User role with limited access to manage request codes within a specific agency.

workflows.name: Request Code Management
steps: Page_Load: Initialize the page and user access.
FillAgencyDropdown: Populate agency dropdown based on user session.
FillDepartmentDropdown: Populate department dropdown based on agency selection.
FillProgramDropdown: Populate program dropdown based on department selection.
RefreshData: Refresh data displayed on the grid.
gridData_RowCommand: Handle add, edit, delete, and reactivate commands for request codes.

business_rules: Only System Administrators can view request codes by Sub Discipline.
ScreenIsEditable is true if the user is a System Administrator or if a Local Administrator belongs to the same agency.
In edit mode, ensure that department dropdown is not empty before allowing add operations.
validations: Ensure Name and ShortName fields are not empty before saving.
conditions: Determines field visibility based on user role and request code type.
Editable conditions based on filled department and program dropdowns.
system_behavior: Controls visibility and actions of buttons like Save, Edit, and Delete based on user permissions.
Updates the grid and UI elements on user interactions like dropdown changes.
dependencies: Uses ASP.NET web controls and AjaxControlToolkit for UI elements.
Interacts with HSPnet data layers and user sessions.
exceptions: If RequestCodeID is zero, add a new request code; otherwise, update the existing one.
Prevent editing if the screen is not editable.
